24: NIKÍTA. No, I'll first drink a samovár with my parent. Go and light the samovár. Akoulína, I say, come here!
22: ANÍSYA. Now then, it's all right, lie down!
21: NIKÍTA. Wife, say where am I standing?
20: ANÍSYA. Go and lie down, I say.
18: NIKÍTA. Drink, what's that? I've been drinking? I'm to blame, that's flat! I've had a glass with a friend, drank his health.
16: AKÍM [ does not answer ] Drink, I mean drink, what it does! It's filthy!
15: ANÍSYA. You look who's in the hut!
13: ANÍSYA [ aside ] He'll go on worrying. [ To Nikíta ] Well then, with the left. Come in!
11: NIKÍTA. Say with which foot he steps? You've got to say it,—that's flat.
9: ANÍSYA. That's enough! You're letting the cold in!
7: NIKÍTA. Ah, that's it. [ Holds on to the door-post ] No, now say with which foot Tchilíkin steps into this house!
5: ANÍSYA [ laughs and pulls him by the arm ] Tchilíkin. Dear me, what airs!
3: NIKÍTA [ still in the doorway ] Ah, that's it! But now—the surname?
0: NIKÍTA. Where have you learnt manners? The full name.
